Population increased in New Forest

The estimated population of New Forest in 2024 was 176,116 usual residents, a rise of 0.2% since 2023.

This meant that New Forest's rate of population change placed it among the slowest growing 20 percent of local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of New Forest decreased by 0.1%.

Over this slightly longer period, New Forest was among one of only five local authorities in England and Wales where the population got smaller.

Age profile of New Forest

The average (median) age rose to 52.4 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of New Forest has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
New Forest is an area that is classed as intermediate urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, New Forest's population of 176,116 usual residents was made up of:

  • 26,249 people aged 0 to 15 years, (14.9%)
  • 95,841 people aged 16 to 64 years, (54.4%)
  • 54,026 people aged 65 years and over, (30.7%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, New Forest has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (30.7% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In New Forest, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from births and deaths.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in New Forest
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for New Forest, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 1,248 people (-0.7%). In total, there were 1,161 births and 2,409 deaths in New Forest.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,164 (0.7%). There were 8,579 people entering the area and 7,415 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in New Forest's population of 450 (0.3%) as a result of 908 people entering the area and 458 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for New Forest was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of New Forest in mid-2023 is 175,724.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 243 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 83 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 326 people.
